
# CL 

## Weight summary 

```{r cl-weight-total}
# Total weights (scientific, official) by year and catch category
CLw <- CL %>%
  group_by(CLyear, CLcatchCat) %>%
  summarise(
    CLoffWeight = sum(CLoffWeight, na.rm = TRUE),
    CLsciWeight = sum(CLsciWeight, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(CLoffWeight, CLsciWeight),
               names_to = "WeightSource", values_to = "Weight")

ggplot(CLw, aes(CLyear, Weight, fill = WeightSource)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  facet_grid(CLcatchCat ~ ., scales = "free") +
  rdbes_theme() +
  ylab("Weight (t)") +
  ggtitle("Total weight by year and catch category")

CLw %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = CLcatchCat, values_from = Weight) %>%
  rdbes_dt(caption = "Total weight annually by catch category and weight source")
```

### By RCG region

#### Annually {.tabset}

```{r cl-weight-rcg-setup}
CLrcg <- left_join(CL, Area, by = c("CLarea" = "AreaCode")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Code))

CLws <- CLrcg %>%
  group_by(CLyear, CLdBasSciWeig, CLdSouSciWeig, CLarea, Code) %>%
  summarise(CLsciWeight = sum(CLsciWeight, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

rcg <- list()
tab <- list()
for (i in unique(CLws$Code)) {
  rcg[[i]] <- ggplot(filter(CLws, Code == i),
                     aes(CLarea, CLsciWeight, fill = CLyear)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
    facet_grid(CLdBasSciWeig ~ CLdSouSciWeig) +
    rdbes_theme()
  tab[[i]] <- filter(CLws, Code == i)
}
```

```{r cl-weight-rcg-plot, results="asis", fig.dim=c(12, 8)}
for (i in names(rcg)) {
  catHeader(i, 5)
  lapply(rcg[i], print)
  print(htmltools::tagList(DT::datatable(tab[[i]], rownames = FALSE, escape = FALSE)))
}
```

### By landing vs vessel flag country

```{r cl-alluvial}
# Summarise to one row per (year, flag country, landing country).
CLvs <- CL %>%
  group_by(CLyear, CLvesFlagCou, CLlanCou) %>%
  summarise(CLsciWeight = sum(CLsciWeight, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(alluvium = row_number())   # unique flow ID required by ggalluvial

# Manually build lodes format: two rows per flow (one per axis)
CLvs_lodes <- bind_rows(
  CLvs %>% mutate(Axis = "Vessel Flag Country", Country = CLvesFlagCou),
  CLvs %>% mutate(Axis = "Landing Country",     Country = CLlanCou)
) %>%
  mutate(Axis = factor(Axis, levels = c("Vessel Flag Country", "Landing Country")))

ggplot(CLvs_lodes,
       aes(x        = Axis,
           y        = CLsciWeight,
           stratum  = Country,
           alluvium = alluvium,
           fill     = Country,
           label    = Country)) +
  geom_flow(alpha = 0.5, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_stratum(alpha = 0.9, colour = "white") +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum", size = 2.8, fontface = "bold", colour = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D", guide = "none") +
  rdbes_theme() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5)) +
  xlab(NULL) +
  ylab("Scientific weight (t)") +
  facet_wrap(. ~ CLyear, scales = "free_y")
```

### By top 20 species

```{r cl-top20-species-helper}
# Helper: build top-20-species data for a given catch category
.top20_species <- function(data, catch_cat) {
  sub <- filter(data, CLcatchCat == catch_cat)
  top20 <- sub %>%
    group_by(LatinName) %>%
    summarise(lvTot = sum(CLsciWeight, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    slice_max(order_by = lvTot, n = 20) %>%
    mutate(Top20CLSpecies = "X")
  sub <- left_join(sub, top20, by = "LatinName") %>%
    mutate(topCLSpecies = if_else(is.na(Top20CLSpecies), "OTH", LatinName))
  sub %>%
    group_by(topCLSpecies, CLyear) %>%
    summarise(
      CLoffWeight = sum(CLoffWeight, na.rm = TRUE),
      CLsciWeight = sum(CLsciWeight, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(CLoffWeight, CLsciWeight),
                 names_to = "CLweightSource", values_to = "CLweight") %>%
    group_by(topCLSpecies) %>%
    mutate(TotW = sum(CLweight, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup()
}
```

```{r cl-top20-lan, eval=doNextChunkLan, results='asis'}
cat("#### Landings \n\n")
CLLoc <- .top20_species(CL, "Lan")
ggplot(CLLoc, aes(reorder(topCLSpecies, -TotW), CLweight, fill = CLyear)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity") +
  facet_wrap(CLweightSource ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
  RDBES_FILL +
  rdbes_theme() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)) +
  xlab("Species") +
  ylab("Weight (t)") +
  labs(fill = "Year")
```


### By metier level 6 (top 20)

```{r cl-top20-metier-helper}
# Helper: build top-20-metier data for a given catch category
.top20_metier <- function(data, catch_cat, group_vars = c("topMetiers", "CLyear")) {
  sub <- filter(data, CLcatchCat == catch_cat)
  top20 <- sub %>%
    group_by(CLmetier6) %>%
    summarise(lwTot = sum(CLsciWeight, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    slice_max(order_by = lwTot, n = 20) %>%
    mutate(Top20metiers = "X")
  sub <- left_join(sub, top20, by = "CLmetier6") %>%
    mutate(topMetiers = if_else(is.na(Top20metiers), "OTH", CLmetier6))
  sub %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group_vars))) %>%
    summarise(CLoffWeight = sum(CLoffWeight, na.rm = TRUE),
              CLsciWeight = sum(CLsciWeight, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_longer(c(CLoffWeight, CLsciWeight),
                 names_to = "CLweightSource", values_to = "CLweight") %>%
    group_by(topMetiers) %>%
    mutate(TotW = sum(CLweight, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup()
}
```

```{r cl-top20-met-lan, eval=doNextChunkLan, results='asis'}
cat("#### Landings \n\n")
CLLoc <- .top20_metier(CL, "Lan")
ggplot(CLLoc, aes(reorder(topMetiers, -TotW), CLweight, fill = CLyear)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity") +
  facet_wrap(CLweightSource ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
  rdbes_theme() +
  xlab("Metier level 6") +
  ylab("Weight (t)")
```

```{r cl-top20-met-bms, eval=doNextChunkBMS, results='asis'}
cat("#### BMS \n\n")
CLLoc <- .top20_metier(CL, "BMS")
ggplot(CLLoc, aes(reorder(topMetiers, -TotW), CLweight, fill = CLweightSource)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity") +
  facet_grid(CLyear ~ .) +

  xlab("Metier level 6") +
```


## Value summary by top 20 species

```{r cl-value}
CLlan_val <- CL %>%
  filter(CLcatchCat == "Lan") %>%
  mutate(CLlanVal = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(CLlanVal)))

top20_val <- CLlan_val %>%
  group_by(LatinName) %>%
  summarise(lvTot = sum(CLlanVal, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  slice_max(order_by = lvTot, n = 20) %>%
  mutate(Top20CLSpecies = "X")

CLval <- left_join(CLlan_val, top20_val, by = "LatinName") %>%
  mutate(topCLSpecies = if_else(is.na(Top20CLSpecies), "OTH", LatinName))

CLvalS <- CLval %>%
  group_by(topCLSpecies, CLyear) %>%
  summarise(CLlanVal = sum(CLlanVal, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(topCLSpecies) %>%
  mutate(TotV = sum(CLlanVal, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(CLvalS, aes(reorder(topCLSpecies, -TotV), CLlanVal, fill = CLyear)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity") +
  rdbes_theme() +
  xlab("Species") +
  ylab("Official landing value")
```

### Value vs weight {.tabset}

```{r cl-val-weight-setup}
CL2 <- filter(CLval, topCLSpecies != "OTH")
val <- list()
for (i in sort(unique(CL2$topCLSpecies))) {
  val[[i]] <- ggplot(filter(CL2, topCLSpecies == i),
                     aes(CLlanVal, CLsciWeight, color = CLyear)) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
    RDBES_COL +
    rdbes_theme() +
    labs(color = "Year")
}
```

```{r cl-val-weight-plot, results='asis'}
for (i in names(val)) {
  catHeader(i, 4)
  lapply(val[i], print)
}
```
